This page lists all **food and drink items** in *Fallout 76*.

Many foods and drink items found in Appalachia are slightly irradiated and can give the player character radiation poisoning. Many also carry the chance of disease.

Some food items can be planted in player C.A.M.P.s and workshops to increase one's food supply. Aside from prepackaged food and a small number of craftable items, uneaten food will spoil over time at which time they will be converted to Spoiled Meat, Spoiled Vegetables or Spoiled Fruit.
